scripts.check:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check
scripts.fix:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format
scripts.test:api: uv run --directory apps/api python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.dev:extension: echo "Load apps/extension as an unpacked extension in Chrome"
scripts.lint: echo "Add linting once the stack is chosen"
